description: Core + plugin permissions for the WordPuppi desktop shell. The fs plugin's static scope is the workspace dir (#426) plus $APPDATA (detach-to-local sqlite exports land in appDataDir/sites/); a dialog-chosen ZIP save path is granted at runtime by the dialog->fs handoff (#491, needs fs:allow-write-file), and the same handoff grants dialog-chosen upload paths for binary reads (#635 file-pick interception avoids the WKWebView native panel crash, needs fs:allow-read-file). opener:default lets the webview open external urls in the default browser (#488). http:default is scoped to exactly the three API bases so the admin's apiRequest runs over native HTTP with no webview CORS (DECISIONS §12). App-defined terminal_* commands are not ACL-gated.
